subject: RedTag handback — commit review & immediate actions
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Hannah Li <hannah.li@acme.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: RedTag handback — commit review & immediate actions

Team / Hannah —

Quick handback on the Acme commit review we ran this morning. Finance asked us to produce a tight R/Y/G list and concrete owner-driven save plans for anything not green by our next forecast refresh (Monday EOD). Goal is to have a single-source checklist so SRE/Finance can sign off on the reforecast.

Immediate asks (please action by Monday COB unless noted):
- Update HubSpot deal stage to the most recent status and add a one-line reason if moving backward (owner: Marissa). Link below.
- Populate the attached "redtag_handback_template.xlsx" with current close probability, blockers, and proposed mitigation with owners and dates (owner: Rafael).
- Confirm any procurement gating items and expected sign date (owner: Sean).
- Flag any dependent rollout or infra capacity asks so we can route to Dedicated ops (cc'ing engineering if needed).

Hannah — appreciate a narrow list of open items from Acme (legal/PO/technical) so we can map to our actions. If there's a preferred date for a hard commit or internal review on your side, share it here.

Mutual action plan (short):
1) Internal tidy (today) — get the RYG populated with owners/dates.
2) Customer confirmation (ASAP) — Acme confirms procurement/technical blockers.
3) Update forecast (Mon) — Finance uses updated RYG to recalc commit.

Attachments: redtag_handback_template.xlsx (spreadsheet: RYG + owner matrix) and ACME_Billing_Notes.pdf (current billing terms summary).

Thanks — keep updates inline for threading.

--
Logan Wright
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Hannah Li <hannah.li@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RedTag handback — commit review & immediate actions

Thanks Logan — I'm on it. Quick status snapshot:

- I've started the RYG sheet and pre-populated 6 named line items from our last call. Current quick read: 2 green, 3 yellow, 1 red. Red is the PO timing (Procurement) + two legal items that Legal estimates could take 7-10 business days if redlines persist.
- Rafael will take ownership of the "yellow" items that need technical clarification (integration test windows / tokenization scope).
- Sean, can you confirm whether billing cadence is blocking for getting a PO through Acme's Sourcing? If they insist on net-90, that could move us to red on ARR recognition.

I attached the template with notes in the "current_status" column. Rafael / Sean — please add your owner names and target dates into columns D/E. We'll push a cleaned version to HubSpot and share the Drive link.

Marissa

Attachments: redtag_handback_template.xlsx
--
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: Hannah Li <hannah.li@acme.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RedTag handback — commit review & immediate actions

Thanks — quick reply from my side.

- Procurement: we're running a mid-quarter vendor batch. My procurement lead (cc'd procurement@acme.com) says PO should hit next Thursday (2027-06-24) assuming we close the SOW redlines today.
- Legal: two minor redlines; legal is OK to expedite if we provide inline responses by EOD Monday.
- Technical: our infra team needs clarification on tokenization and network egress — Rafael, can you confirm whether those are optional or required for GA?

I'll mark the items green/yellow/red on our side once Rafael confirms the tech ask. Appreciate the template — I updated row 3 with the procurement ETA.

- Hannah

Team —

Nice progress so far. Quick consolidation before Finance locks the numbers:
- Rafael: please confirm tokenization/egress classification by 2027-06-20 17:00 PT and indicate whether that adds a configuration or an additional purchase (label in sheet).
- Sean: confirm procurement cadence (Net-30 vs Net-90) and whether we can accept a purchase order with monthly invoicing. If Net-90 is required, mark as "red" for revenue timing.
- Marissa: push the cleaned RYG into HubSpot and tag "Forecast: Q3-Notify". I'll call out the red item in today's forecast deck.

Hannah — appreciate your procurement ETA. If legal can commit to inline responses by EOD Monday we should be in a good place for the PO next Thursday.

I'll consolidate and send the final single-slide save-plan to Finance by 17:30 PT. If anything changes, flag immediately in thread.

Thanks all,

Logan
